+import os

+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+

+            {"role": "user", "content": text},
+        ],
+    )
+    return response.output_text

+    if len(args) > 1:
+        return " ".join(args[1:])
+    return sys.stdin.read()
+
+

+    text = _read_input(sys.argv)
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise SystemExit(1)
+    print(translate_text(text))
+
+
